name: Savings Jar
description: Savings kept until a date. Anyone can pay into a jar. From its date on, whoever holds the jar's key can empty it.

saver.name: Saver
saver.description: Opens a jar, pays into it, and empties it from its date on.

open.name: Open a savings jar
open.description: Make a new jar with its key, and pay the first savings in. They stay in the jar until its date.

deposit.name: Pay into a savings jar
deposit.description: Add savings to a jar. They stay there until the jar's date.

withdraw.name: Empty a savings jar
withdraw.description: Take everything out of the jar. Possible from the jar's date on. The key stays with you, so the jar can be used again.

openTransaction.name: Savings jar opened
openTransaction.description: A savings jar was opened with $(<savedSatoshis>) satoshis.

depositTransaction.name: Paid into a savings jar
depositTransaction.description: $(<savedSatoshis>) satoshis were added to a savings jar.

withdrawTransaction.name: Savings jar emptied
withdrawTransaction.description: Everything was taken out of a savings jar.

savingsJarInput.name: Savings jar
savingsJarInput.description: Savings in the jar. They need no signature: the jar's key in the same transaction opens it.

savingsJarOutput.name: Savings jar
savingsJarOutput.description: $(<savedSatoshis>) satoshis kept until the jar's date.

jarKeyOutput.name: Jar key
jarKeyOutput.description: The token that opens this jar. Keep it in the wallet.

savingsJarLockingScript.name: Savings jar
savingsJarLockingScript.description: Savings kept until the jar's date; then whoever spends the jar's key in the same transaction can take them out.

keyCategory.name: Jar key
keyCategory.description: The token category of the jar's key.

unlockTime.name: Opens on
unlockTime.description: When the jar can be emptied, as a Unix time.

unlockTimeBytes.name: Date on the key
unlockTimeBytes.description: The same time, as it is written on the jar's key.

savedSatoshis.name: Amount to save
savedSatoshis.description: Satoshis to put into the jar.

keyHolder.name: Key holder
keyHolder.description: Where the jar's key goes: an address of the wallet.

keyInput.name: Key input
keyInput.description: The number of the input that spends the jar's key.
